{{Quote|Sir, that appears to be a ''memory flush unit''--|C-3PO|<ref name="SW20" />}}
A '''memory flush unit''' was used to perform [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] on [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

==Description==
A memory flush unit was a device that could be carried by hand that was used to perform [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]]. In order to perform this wipe the memory flush unit must have access to a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] inner workings. For instance, on a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] the faceplate must be removed.<ref name="SW20" />

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were sold to raise a gambling stake by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] while they were trapped on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]]. Han Solo intended to redeem the droids later, but [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]], the station administrator, ordered the droids' memories wiped to remove evidence of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] plot. The [[Technician/Legends|technician]] sent to do the job brought a memory flush unit, but he was stopped at the last moment by the station's [[Master-Com]], who rescued the droids.<ref name="SW20" />
